sloka: न हि धर्मविरुद्धेषु बह्वपायेषु कर्मसु ।मूलघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः ।। ५.५१.१८।।।।
transliteration: na hi dharmaviruddheṣu bahvapāyeṣu karmasu ।mūlaghātiṣu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvidhāḥ ।। 5.51.18।।।।

translations.english: "Indeed, respectable people and wise men like you should not indulge in actions opposed to righteousness as it will strike at the very root of your existence.
